rockdesk.description: Operate another computer by its 9-digit RockDesk ID: run shell commands with real exit codes, start background jobs, copy files, take screenshots, click and type, read and set the clipboard, forward ports. Connects peer-to-peer and falls back to an end-to-end encrypted relay; no public IP, open port or SSH server needed. Install the RockDesk app on both computers first: https://rockdesk.io/#download
